scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: server_pid=0; client_pid=0; cleanup() { kill $server_pid $client_pid 2>/dev/null || true; }; trap cleanup INT TERM EXIT; npm run dev --prefix server & server_pid=$!; npm run dev --prefix client & client_pid=$!; wait
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.db:init: npm run db:start && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && npm run db:check
